entries.title: Queued tasks say what they are waiting for
entries.body: Tasks now name what they wait for and when that wait began, whether it is the first mate’s go, a computer or another task. Your first mate reads the same line without starting a crewmate to investigate. The Tasks panel shows the extra line only in Queued, keeping Backlog compact.

picture.alt: Task board showing a queued project build waiting for its project plan, with the time the wait began.
